description: The file defines the ContainerLoader class, responsible for loading, starting, and unloading container components within the OFBiz framework. It manages container initialization based on configuration, maintains the list of active containers, and handles lifecycle operations such as load, start, and unload. The class interacts with other classes like ContainerConfig, Container, Config, and StartupCommand to facilitate container management during application startup and shutdown.

classes.name: ContainerLoader
classes.description: This class manages the lifecycle of containers in the OFBiz framework, providing methods to load, start, and unload container components during application startup and shutdown.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and initializes containers based on configuration and startup commands, handling setup for mandatory and configurable containers, throwing StartupException if critical errors occur.

methods.name: intersects
methods.description: Utility method that checks whether two collections have an intersection or are both empty, used to determine if a container configuration matches specified loaders.

methods.name: loadContainersFromConfigurations
methods.description: Iterates over container configurations and loads those that match specified loaders, returning a list of instantiated container objects.

methods.name: loadContainer
methods.description: Loads a specific container class by name, creates an instance, and initializes it with the provided startup commands and configuration name.

methods.name: startLoadedContainers
methods.description: Iterates over loaded containers and initiates their startup sequence, throwing StartupException if starting any container fails.

methods.name: unload
methods.description: Shuts down all loaded containers in reverse order, handling exceptions and logging the shutdown process.
